title: Why South African Business Prioritise Digital Marketing

facts.fact: A research finding cited on the page reports that 85% of mobile advertisers feel they are giving their customers value for money.
facts.quote: 85% of mobile advertisers feel that they are giving their customers value for money, however

facts.fact: The same cited research reports that only 47% of mobile users agree that advertisers give them value for money.
An unattributed statistic cited on the page says online marketing in South Africa is increasing at a rate of 35%.
facts.quote: According to statistics online marketing is increasing at a rate of 35%

facts.fact: Reports released at the end of 2018 state that online shopping in South Africa is worth R14 billion.
facts.quote: reports released at the end of 2018 state that online shopping is now worth R14 billion.

facts.fact: The page states that online shopping's 2018 value of R14 billion represents a 25% increase over 2017 figures.
facts.quote: This represents a 25% increase over 2017 figures.

facts.fact: The page predicts that South African social media users will soon reach the 40 million mark.
facts.quote: It is predicted that users of social media will reach the 40 million mark soon.

facts.fact: As of the third quarter of 2018, Facebook had 2.27 billion active users.
facts.quote: With 2.27 billion active users – as of the third quarter of 2018

facts.fact: The page states that LinkedIn has over 52 million users.
facts.quote: With over 52 million users, it provides vital information for marketers in the B2B space

facts.fact: The page states that 40 million LinkedIn users hold decision-maker positions in their businesses.
facts.quote: 40 million LinkedIn users are hold the position of decision makers in the business.
